tryAgain: Listen again — which word sounds the same at the end?

verseText.en:
Little Kancil hops so light,
Over the log, out of sight.

The river flows both night and day,
It carries leaves so far away.

In the cave so dark and deep,
All the forest friends will sleep.

Across the bridge, so brown and old,
Kancil walks, brave and bold.

Yellow flowers in the sun,
We pick and play, having fun.

Up the hill and past the stone,
Kancil never walks alone.

High up in the tree so tall,
A little bird has built its nest so small.
